name: Vercel
desc: Deploy projects and manage environment variables on Vercel.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: Retrieve all Vercel projects for the authenticated user or team.

actions.name: create_deployment
actions.description: Create a deployment for an existing Vercel project using either a redeploy source deployment ID or a git source payload.

actions.name: get_deployment_status
actions.description: Retrieve a deployment and inspect its current status.

actions.name: list_environment_variables
actions.description: Retrieve environment variables for a Vercel project.

actions.name: upsert_environment_variable
actions.description: Create or update a Vercel environment variable using Vercel's upsert API.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to Vercel. The Authorization header is injected automatically. If your connection uses Team ID or Team Slug, add `teamId` or `slug` manually in the URL or Query Parameters for team-scoped requests.
